whoYouAre.title: Which Seiyuu Are You
whoYouAre.subtitle: Which voice actress are you most like? · v1.0
whoYouAre.intro: Six temperament axes and {{count}} candidate voice actresses from LoveLive!, BanG Dream!, Project SEKAI, THE IDOLM@STER, Gakuen Idolmaster, Uma Musume, Revue Starlight and D4DJ. You get the name you match most, how close the match is, a full similarity ranking, the one you are most different from, and a shareable result code.
whoYouAre.guide: Each question has five options: strongly agree, agree, neutral, disagree, strongly disagree. There are no right answers — go with your first instinct. A few hidden results trigger when your answers are extremely one-sided or suspiciously even.

eggDesc.e_all_agree: You strongly agreed with every single question — you just like the hype.
eggDesc.e_all_disagree: You strongly disagreed with every single question. Your compatibility with this world is questionable.
eggDesc.e_speedrun: Fast and extreme — you were not taking a test, you were venting.
eggDesc.e_flat: All six axes sit near the middle. You are that glass of warm water.
eggDesc.e_polar: At least four axes were pushed to the extreme. There is nothing vague about your personality.
eggDesc.e_all_neutral: Neutral on every question. Safe, but very hard to read.
eggDesc.e_speed: Finished in under 40 seconds. Your first instinct is sharper than your second thoughts.
eggDesc.e_skipped: You skipped more than 30% of the questions. Respect — some people just do not want to be defined.

questions.m9: My laugh and tear thresholds are both embarrassingly low — even an advert can mist me up.
questions.m10: I hardly show feelings in front of others; I process the good and the bad alone.
questions.m11: When emotion hits I cannot hide it — happy means literally bouncing.
questions.m12: Even when the whole room is cheering, part of me is watching through glass.
questions.e9: I say things on the spot; going the long way round physically hurts.
questions.e10: I read the room before I speak, even if that means swallowing it.
questions.e11: If I like it I say so, if I do not I say that too. What others think is their business.
questions.e12: I rarely put feelings into words; I show them by doing.
questions.s9: The bigger the crowd the more wired I get — quiet actually feels bad.
questions.s10: After socialising I need time alone before I can recharge.
questions.s11: Adding a stranger is not intimidating to me at all.
questions.s12: Group chat messages I usually read and leave. Replying is rare.
questions.p9: I am full of ideas and bits, ready to catch any joke at any moment.
questions.p10: I am not much of a joker — bits usually sail straight past me.
questions.p11: The moment a room goes flat, I start looking for ways to fire it up.
questions.p12: More than noise, I like the solid feeling of finishing something properly.
questions.d9: I set myself brutal targets; missing one keeps me awake.
questions.d10: Good enough is good enough — I will not trade life for work.
questions.d11: “Whatever” is unbearable to me; I want everything done as well as possible.
questions.d12: I dislike competition. Winning or losing barely matters.
questions.t9: The things I love are niche; the more mainstream, the less I care.
questions.t10: I do not really get the idea that obscurity equals quality.
questions.t11: My taste runs sharp — odd is fine by me.
questions.t12: I prefer the classic, the safe, the thing that does not miss.
questions.c9: The moment I am happy I want to drag everyone into some scheme.
questions.c10: The lower my mood, the more I reach for something obscure.
questions.c11: I am not one for pretty words, but nothing I owe gets skipped.
questions.c12: I love hanging out with people, but not enough to fight my way up a career.
questions.c13: I do not go wild when I play, but my taste is picky.
questions.c14: My feelings show, and I need somebody there to see them.
questions.c15: I say exactly what I think, with little thought for delivery.
questions.c16: When I am serious I do not want to play, and when I play I do not want business talk.
questions.m1: You are the first to shout a greeting when you spot someone you know.
questions.m2: At a party you would rather watch quietly from a corner.
questions.m3: Your resting face is a smile.
questions.m4: People often tell you that you look a bit cold.
questions.m5: You are already full of energy first thing in the morning.
questions.m6: You speak quietly, and rather slowly.
questions.m7: When you get excited, your voice gets noticeably louder.
questions.m8: You tend not to smile in photos.
questions.e1: At a concert you sing and shout along.
questions.e2: However moved you are, you rarely cry in the moment.
questions.e3: Your feelings are written all over your face.
questions.e4: When you are angry, you actually go quieter.
questions.e5: You cheer out loud when you open a present.
questions.e6: In public you almost never talk about your private life.
questions.e7: If you like someone, you say it out loud.
questions.e8: You turn things over in your head before you speak.
questions.s1: Breaking the ice with strangers is not hard for you.
questions.s2: A dinner with more than three people drains you.
questions.s3: You are usually the one who organizes get-togethers.
questions.s4: You prefer talking one on one.
questions.s5: You will walk up and start chatting with classmates or coworkers.
questions.s6: It takes you a long time to feel at home somewhere new.
questions.s7: You enjoy going back and forth with people in the comments.
questions.s8: Time alone is a basic need for you.
questions.p1: You start the jokes and bits, and you love making people laugh.
questions.p2: In a formal setting you would never joke around.
questions.p3: When you see a weird meme you save it and send it on right away.
questions.p4: You find it hard to accept people acting silly in front of you.
questions.p5: There is usually a comic tone in the way you talk.
questions.p6: Your desk and your room are impeccably tidy.
questions.p7: You will drop your dignity if the joke is funny enough.
questions.p8: You dislike being interrupted with jokes while you work.
questions.d1: Losing really bothers you for a long time.
questions.d2: Rankings and placements do not mean much to you.
questions.d3: Once you set a goal, you push yourself until it is done.
questions.d4: When plans fall apart, your reaction is "that is fine too".
questions.d5: When people compare you with someone else, you want to win.
questions.d6: You rarely compete for first place.
questions.d7: You put in extra practice on your own to get better.
questions.d8: "Good enough" is one of your favourite phrases.
questions.t1: On weekends you would rather go out and shop than stay in with anime.
questions.t2: You will stay up all night chasing down one lore detail.
questions.t3: You study outfits and makeup seriously.
questions.t4: Your shopping cart is all merchandise and fan works.
questions.t5: You would rather spend money on experiences and travel.
questions.t6: You remember the fine details of a show better than your daily life.
questions.t7: You spend time on your appearance before leaving the house.
questions.t8: On a day off you want to game and watch anime at home.
questions.c1: At a live show you shout the calls along with everyone else.
questions.c2: You are far more outgoing online than in person.
questions.c3: You share obscure material you just dug up in the group chat.
questions.c4: When someone praises you, you take it without protest.
questions.c5: You put on a completely different face in formal situations.
questions.c6: You will take a day off work to make it to an event.
questions.c7: People often say you seem different from their first impression.
questions.c8: You are better at finishing the behind-the-scenes work alone.
